newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cr Lyonnais H1 profit 67 million Ffr.
newsitem.headline: Cr Lyonnais H1 profit 67 million Ffr.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
Net banking income 21.5 bln vs 22.1 bln
Gross operating profit 4.2 bln up 20.1 pct
Shareholders funds including minority interests and the Fund
for General Banking Risks 43,884 vs NA

Note - State-controlled Credit Lyonnais said in a statement that on a constant structure basis, stripping out the effect of its loan to state rescue vehicle EPFR and non-recurring items, net banking income rose 3.9 percent.
It said gross operating profit on a constant structure basis, stripping out the impact of the loan to EPFR and non-recurring items, was up 18.4 percent.
The results included a 35 million franc payment to the state under last year's government rescue which dictated that the bank must pay a third of its profits to the state until 2014.
The previous year's figures were restated to reflect accounting changes.
